title: Cocktails
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael attempts to escape from bondage using magic, while navigating complex relationships with Jan and others at a party. The episode explores Michael and Jan's relationship, Jan's attraction to 'weird, wrong men,' and various social interactions among the characters, culminating in emotional disagreements and reflections on their day.

main_threads.thread: Michael's relationship with Jan and his escape attempt
